16.name: Give Gerard a Drink
16.details: Farming is thirsty work, and I'm always looking for refreshing spring water.$B$BIf you have any, then I'm willing to make a trade.$BRefreshing Spring Water (1)
16.completion: Thanks, $N! And come back if you want to trade again.
